name: Dawnsire
description: A vast javelin-shaped Sunstar ship carrying a horizon javelin that can unmake a supervoid into a star, and two laser batteries called Nacho and Nacha.

timeline.summary: Raphaella's final transmission explains the Monoist purpose, describes the Dawnsire and Candela, and bids farewell as her inevitor falls toward Sothera.
timeline.quote: that we will destroy the Dawnsire

timeline.summary: The Monoist inevitors launch toward the Dawnsire, and Alpharael learns they will hit at thirty kilometers a second.
timeline.quote: We hit it at thirty kilometers a second.

timeline.summary: Vondam and Haliya go to the Dawnsire's bridge and meet Captain Slats, an Astelli, who phorocasts that Vondam will die in the battle.
timeline.quote: I phorocast that you die in the battle.

timeline.summary: The bridge darkens red as phorocast detects an imminent impact, and Slats orders collision alarms and the deployment of knights.
timeline.quote: Garrison to repel boarders, number-two basilica!

timeline.summary: The inevitor strikes the Dawnsire and deploys a cherazad that suspends most of the impact.
timeline.quote: As it strikes the Dawnsire , the inevitor deploys a cyst of altered space, a tactical event horizon: a cherazad.

timeline.summary: The narrator explains the horizon javelin at the Dawnsire's heart.
timeline.quote: The mechanism that undoes a supervoid into a star is in fact called a horizon javelin.

timeline.summary: Nacha fires a laser pulse train across two hundred lightseconds at Susur Secundi.
Alpharael's warmaker burns away from the Dawnsire, unremarked by anyone.
timeline.quote: And if any of those eyes take note of the Hopelight warmaker burning furiously away from the Dawnsire , headed anywhere but home—they do not say.

timeline.summary: Vondam and Haliya left the Dawnsire in a secret rush, telling no one, not even Captain Slats.
timeline.quote: They left the Dawnsire in a secret rush, telling no one, not even Captain Slats.

timeline.summary: Sami learns that the Dawnsire carries a weapon to turn Sothera back into a sun.
timeline.quote: Wait. Undo sekhar? Are you talking about turning Sothera back into a real sun?

timeline.summary: Haliya traveled to Sothera aboard the Dawnsire, which will reignite the supervoid.
timeline.quote: She traveled there aboard the Dawnsire , a horizon javelin and kilometers-long vessel that will reignite the Sotheran supervoid—something the system's Monoists will do anything to prevent.

timeline.summary: Vondam commands a knightly host assigned to defend the Dawnsire.
timeline.quote: Syr Vondam is a high-ranking knight of the Sunstar Free Company who commands a knightly host assigned to defend the Dawnsire .

relations.note: the Candela shields and escorts the Dawnsire
relations.quote: it is escorted by the Candela, a shieldship of formidable heritage and warcraft.

relations.note: Slats is captain of the Dawnsire.
relations.quote: My name is Slats. I'm the captain of this instrument, and the coronal of the faithful aboard.

pages_say.description: The Sunstar Free Company's dreadnought needle-like weapon built to survive a supervoid's firewall, a horizon javelin charging to reignite Sothera.
A vast javelin-shaped Sunstar ship carrying a horizon javelin that can unmake a supervoid into a star, and two laser batteries called Nacho and Nacha.
The Sunstar ship from which Alpharael escaped.
The Sunstar ship Vondam and Haliya left in secret.
The Sunstar ship carrying a weapon that can reignite supervoids as stars.
The Sunstar ship with a weapon that can reignite supervoids as stars; both sides hold weapons in reserve for a confrontation over it.
A kilometers-long horizon javelin vessel that will reignite the Sotheran supervoid.
